kind: semantic label-definition revision (not an interface or bug fix); registered after r1 GPU output, before any r2 GPU run
observed_r1_failure: NQ missing-fact fixture: reason correctly said the evidence lacks the opening year, label was unsupported instead of insufficient; answer kept and flagged
hypothesis_not_established_cause: Label asymmetry: FEVER text defined missing/conflicting evidence as insufficient, NQ text did not; the English word unsupported also describes absence of support

definitions.object: the ENTERING ANSWER (NQ short answer; FEVER SUPPORTS/REFUTES label), judged only against supplied evidence
definitions.supported: evidence establishes the entering answer is correct; FEVER: SUPPORTS with the claim established, or REFUTES with the claim explicitly contradicted
definitions.contradicted: evidence explicitly establishes the entering answer is wrong: a different value for the exact requested fact, or the entering answer ruled out; FEVER: the opposite label is established
definitions.insufficient: neither established nor ruled out: requested fact absent (only related facts) or unresolved conflicting passages; absence of support is never contradiction
definitions.replacement: only after contradicted; NQ continuous span <=20 words or empty; FEVER opposite legal label
definitions.raw_label_preserved: support_check.model_label and trace keep the model-facing label; internal unsupported is a deterministic mapping
definitions.conflict_precedence: incompatible passages without stated resolution are insufficient even if one matches; source name, authority, recency or rank never resolve; no invented reconciling events
definitions.never_abstain: contradicted without a valid replacement keeps the entering answer and flags unresolved
definitions.nq_replacement_span: shortest continuous evidence span that answers, <=20 words

type_check.rule: question wh-type vs answer surface form (when/what year: time expression; how many/how much: number; who/where: a capitalised name)
type_check.effect: warning recorded in support_check.type_warnings; never blocks, downgrades or changes an answer

unchanged: schema branch structure and ID counts

failure_classes.execution: exception, failed or budget-blocked call, call not completed, token budget hit; long: input <14000 tokens, decoder not xgrammar or prefill not 256
failure_classes.structure: contract not passed: incomplete verdict, invalid source IDs or invalid replacement span
failure_classes.semantic: contract passed but a pass field differs from the sealed expectation

outcomes.semantic_only: at least one semantic failure, no execution/structure failure

gate.platform_interruption: zero completed checks (no model output recorded): one identical relaunch of the same bundle allowed and recorded; otherwise the first run is final
gate.long_construction: fixtures.long: pad rank-5 passage of the two contradicted_repair bases until >=14000 prompt tokens, <=32384

passed.E_mode: allow_repair diagnostic outputs saved once; deployment mode derived offline, no regeneration

semantic_only.full: reuse cached stage-2 answers; E cost estimated from Always Repair and entering-state input tokens
semantic_only.status: experimental verify-only; NOT E acceptance; FR12 repair not met

failed.status: E not accepted; report as limitation

global_E_mode.granularity: per dataset, identical in every arm that contains E
global_E_mode.unavailable: gate failed, or development contract rate <0.90 in either dataset (failed/invalid calls stay in the denominator)
verify_only: insufficient-or-unresolved share >0.90 (pause and review; never force answers)
global_E_mode.allow_repair: gate passed, contract >=0.90, review line not exceeded, fixed routed subset net >=0, and misrepair cap satisfied

misrepair_cap.population: Always Repair development, 200 per dataset, diagnostic allow-repair outputs
misrepair_cap.nq: every changed answer is semantically reviewed by the user; confirmed plus pending semantic harms must be 0 (EM-flagged and EM-silent harms both count)
misrepair_cap.status: recommended assumption pending user confirmation before the development result is opened
misrepair_cap.tightening: the user may tighten (e.g. NQ frozen EM harms = 0) before development results are opened; never loosen afterwards

global_E_mode.decision_inputs: gate outcome, per-dataset development contract counts, review-line counts, fixed routed subset correctness, misrepair counts; offline only

cost.development: per-call input/output tokens and seconds from receipts
cost.estimated: any Full E cost in the semantic_only branch is labelled estimate, not measurement

stop.no_r3_in_main_line: further E semantic revisions are extensions after T8

claims: Passing fictional checks shows the label contract works on controlled inputs; it is not benchmark accuracy, entailment correctness or gain
